visualCharacteristics: Section head with a large title above a narrow rich-text lead column; optional ice or dark band background.
contentPattern: Cell 1 heading (h2/h3), cell 2 rich text; order-tolerant (first heading = title, rest = text).
usage: Use as the heading and short lead introducing a roadmap or step sequence.
reuseGuidance: Reuse above accordions or step lists that need a titled intro; choose ice or dark to match the band.
